summary: Frontend-only verification of the newly simplified Customer → Create Shipment single-page flow. Login via OTP (phone +96890000001, demo OTP shown dynamically via [data-testid=demo-otp-hint]) succeeded and landed on /customer. The Create Shipment page renders at /customer/create (NOT /customer/shipments/new as stated in the request — see note). Verified page is a single-page scrolling form (no wizard). All expected data-testids present (section-what, ship-title, photo-upload-label, photo-input, remove-photo, section-from, pickup-map-*, pickup-confirmed, section-to, delivery-map-*, delivery-confirmed, section-when, ship-pickup-date/time, ship-delivery-date/time, section-services with exactly 3 checkboxes chk-fragile/chk-loading_service/chk-unloading_service, section-summary, summary-title/route/dates/services, publish-btn). No forbidden fields (vehicle type, expected price, quantity/weight/dimensions, category, step indicator, next/back buttons) present. Validation: empty description → toast 'Please enter a shipment title'. Filled description + no locations → toast 'Please select the pickup and delivery locations.'. Photo upload/remove works. MapPicker search (Muscat/Salalah via Nominatim) returned results, selection + confirm produced pickup-confirmed and delivery-confirmed with human-readable addresses. Dates/times all accepted. Services checkboxes update summary live. POST /api/shipments returned 200 with vehicle_type='' and expected_price='' accepted; page redirected to /customer/shipments and success toast shown. Verified on mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080 — layout identical, 3 checkboxes both viewports.
action_items: Route mismatch with request spec: request states path '/customer/shipments/new' but the actual registered route (CustomerPortal.jsx) is '/customer/create'. Everything else works; if the spec URL is required for external deep-links, either add a redirect (/customer/shipments/new -> /customer/create) or update spec/docs. In-app buttons (nav-create, bottomnav-create, home-create-shipment-btn) all point to the working route so end-users are unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateShipment.jsx currently posts required_capacity: '' — request only mentioned vehicle_type and expected_price as backend-accepted empty strings; confirm backend ShipmentCreate also accepts empty string for required_capacity (currently working, returns 200).
Demo OTP hint reveals code in the UI ([data-testid=demo-otp-hint]) — fine for demo but must be gated behind a non-production flag before shipping.
MapPicker relies on Nominatim (public OSM) with no rate-limit backoff — could fail under investor demo load. Consider a fallback/error state (already handled with resolveError and retryResolve).
publish-btn triggers submit even during resolving state of MapPicker — but since it requires a confirmed pickup/delivery this is not currently exploitable.
test_credentials: Customer phone +96890000001, demo OTP dynamic (read from [data-testid=demo-otp-hint]).
seed_data_creation: One PUBLISHED shipment created during test: title 'Deliver 20 boxes ceramics Muscat to Salalah', pickup=Muscat, delivery=Salalah (Dhofar). Persisted (not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Create Shipment simplified flow verified end-to-end. Real route is /customer/create; the request's /customer/shipments/new URL currently 404-redirects to /customer home. MapPicker Nominatim search + confirm reliably works from Playwright — search 'Muscat' / 'Salalah' and click the first result. Demo OTP must be parsed from [data-testid=demo-otp-hint] at runtime — do NOT hardcode 243150.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the tested flow. Only note is the URL path mismatch between spec ('/customer/shipments/new') and actual route ('/customer/create').
